content.sentence: The senior technician __________ the live wire by mistake, and the breaker tripped suddenly.
Yesterday, the trainees __________ the insulation on the cable, so dangerous sparks appeared near the panel.
__________ the electrician __________ the emergency power switch when the transformer overheated?
The supervisor __________ the smoke alarm quickly when it came on by accident.
The junior trainee __________ the damaged socket without checking the load, and it sparked dangerously.
The instructor __________ the main breaker immediately after noticing a burning smell near the distribution board.
__________ the team __________ all the extension cords before the rainwater entered the workshop?
The trainees __________ the overheated coil in time, so the motor caught fire.
The electrician __________ the exposed copper strands and prevented a serious short circuit.
The technician __________ the control panel wrongly, and the entire line shut down suddenly.
__________ the supervisor __________ the grounding cable before testing the new machine?
The maintenance team __________ the loose terminal properly, so the whole system vibrated dangerously.

activity_b.text: The senior technician touched the live wire by mistake, and the breaker tripped suddenly.
Yesterday, the trainees didn’t remove the insulation on the cable, so dangerous sparks appeared near the panel.
Did the electrician press the emergency power switch when the transformer overheated?
The supervisor silenced the smoke alarm quickly when it came on by accident.
The junior trainee repaired the damaged socket without checking the load, and it sparked dangerously.
The instructor shut off the main breaker immediately after noticing a burning smell near the distribution board.
Did the team unplug all the extension cords before the rainwater entered the workshop?
The trainees didn’t cool the overheated coil in time, so the motor caught fire.
The electrician noticed the exposed copper strands and prevented a serious short circuit.
The technician configured the control panel wrongly, and the entire line shut down suddenly.
Did the supervisor check the grounding cable before testing the new machine?
The maintenance team didn’t tighten the loose terminal properly, so the whole system vibrated dangerously.

Questions.question: What caused the steam incident last month?
Questions.answer: The students didn’t follow the checklist.
options: The students did not check the temperature carefully.
The students partly followed the checklist.
The students didn’t follow the checklist.

Questions.question: How should trainees react if they smell gas?
Questions.answer: Move away and inform a supervisor immediately.
options: Move away and inform a supervisor immediately.
Move away and inform the student in charge.

Questions.question: What happened when a student mixed chemicals last week?
How should trainees respond to exposed electrical wires?
Questions.answer: Switch off the machine and inform the instructor.
options: Switch off the machine and inform the instructor.
Switch off all machines and inform some fellow students.

Questions.question: What is the main message about emergencies?
Questions.answer: Stay calm and look for the evacuation path.
options: Work fast and complete your task.
Stay calm and move away from the evacuation path.
Stay calm and look for the evacuation path.

activity_c.text: Today, I want to talk to you about handling some of the more serious emergencies that can occur on the workshop floor.
These situations are not meant to scare you, but to help you stay safe and confident while you work.
Always take a moment to check the pressure gauge before you begin.
Last month, one group didn’t follow the checklist properly, and the steamer released hot steam all of a sudden.
This morning, we noticed a possible gas leak, so the maintenance team is working on it right now.
If this ever happens while you’re around, don’t switch on any electrical device and step away from the area.
Last week, someone accidentally mixed two powerful sanitisers, and the fumes irritated people’s eyes.
We also need to pay attention to electrical safety.
Yesterday, a damaged cable was left near the chiller, and the student who noticed it didn’t report it.
A quick report can prevent a big problem.
